title: Sortable
summary: A pointer, touch and keyboard reorder list. Children are pk-sortable-item: drag a row's handle, or focus a row and press Alt+Up or Alt+Down. Never reorders its own children (the host applies the order from pk-reorder); it can also accept a row dragged in from outside it, for a palette-to-canvas drop.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The axis rows lay out and reorder along; Alt+Up/Alt+Down always means earlier/later in the list, whichever axis that is.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No row can be grabbed, dropped on or moved by the keyboard.

props.name: acceptExternal
props.description: Lets a source outside this list drop a new row in, through beginExternalDrag / externalDragOver / endExternalDrag. Off by default, so a plain reorder list never becomes an accidental drop target.

props.name: dragging
props.description: True while a row of this list, or an external drag, is being dragged over it. A styling hook the element sets itself.

slots.description: pk-sortable-item children, in the current order.

events.name: pk-reorder
events.detail: { order, item, from, to, external, payload? }
events.description: A reorder was committed: a drag ended over a new position, or Alt+Up/Alt+Down moved the focused row. order is the new list of every row's value, in order (the host applies it: pk-sortable never moves its own children); item, from and to describe the row that moved. For a drop accepted from outside the list (external: true, through endExternalDrag) order, item and from are null, to is the index to insert at, and payload is whatever beginExternalDrag(payload) was called with. Not cancelable: the gesture already happened.

parts.name: announcer
parts.description: The visually-hidden aria-live region that announces a reorder or a drop for a screen reader.

methods.name: moveOrder(order, from, to)
methods.description: The new order with one item relocated; pure.

methods.name: keyMove(key, index, length)
methods.description: The index Alt+Up or Alt+Down asks for.

methods.name: dropIndex(mids, pos)
methods.description: The insertion index a pointer position means.

methods.name: beginExternalDrag(payload)
methods.description: Called by a source outside the list, on its own pointerdown, to start tracking a drag it owns.

methods.name: externalDragOver(x, y)
methods.description: Called on that source's pointermove; updates the drop-indicator and returns whether the point is a valid drop (accept-external must be set).

methods.name: endExternalDrag(commit)
methods.description: Called on that source's pointerup (commit) or pointercancel (commit: false); raises pk-reorder and returns the index, or null when nothing was accepted.

writes.why: dragging marks the row being dragged; drop-indicator marks the neighbour to draw the insertion line against (cleared when the drag ends); tabindex is the roving focus stop. Refreshed on every drag step and every update; none is undone on disconnect (tabindex stays wherever the list last put it, like pk-tree and pk-tabs).

a11y: role=list; each pk-sortable-item is role=listitem with aria-roledescription and aria-disabled. One tab stop (roving tabindex, skipping disabled rows); Up, Down, Home and End move it; Alt+Up and Alt+Down move the focused row and keep focus on it (a disabled row cannot be focused or moved). A visually-hidden aria-live=polite region announces a grab, a completed or cancelled reorder, and an accepted external drop.
mobile: The handle is a 44px touch target on a touch screen (@media (pointer: coarse), (--phone)); touch-action is off on it so a drag reorders instead of scrolling the page.

examples.title: Horizontal, accepting an external drop
examples.html:
<pk-sortable label="Pinned tags" orientation="horizontal" accept-external>
  <pk-sortable-item value="urgent">Urgent</pk-sortable-item>
  <pk-sortable-item value="review">Needs review</pk-sortable-item>
</pk-sortable>
